name: Laundry & dry cleaning (category guide)
summary: Neighbourhood coin laundry vs pickup dry-clean — curtain/sofa add-ons, hotel-press pricing traps, and why weekly bags are not end-of-lease cleaning.
body: Expat households usually need three different products: self-service / drop-off wash-fold for weekly clothes, garment dry-clean for suits and delicate labels, and occasional curtain / sofa / duvet cleaning — bundling all three into one ‘laundry’ WhatsApp vendor is how prices and damage disputes explode. Ask whether the shop owns its plant or brokers to a third-party factory; turnaround, stain liability, and eco-solvent claims differ. Pickup/delivery apps are convenient in condo landings but read minimum-order and express surcharges. Dry-clean price lists that look cheap per shirt often omit silk, pleats, or wedding-dress tiers — photograph stains before drop-off and keep the ticket. Recurring laundry is not a substitute for professional end-of-lease cleaning clauses in a TA; landlords still expect reinstatement cleans separate from your weekly bag. Pair with furnishing and inventory guides when curtains were landlord-supplied. This is a category guide, not a ranked shop list.
whenToEngage: Need wash-fold vs dry-clean split for a household
Condo pickup minimums / express fees unclear
Landlord curtains need cleaning before handover
Tempted to use weekly laundry to satisfy lease-end clean clause
